Les quatre épreuves

Four papers, twenty-five points each

Every DELF level tests the same four skills. The companion trains each one the way it is examined, so exam day feels familiar.

0125 pts
Listening

Compréhension de l'oral

Short recordings, usually played twice. Read the questions first, then listen for what matters.

Audio documents with transcripts, and two plays per document in exam mode.
0225 pts
Reading

Compréhension des écrits

From notices and short messages at A1 to opinion articles at B2.

The whole document stays beside every question, so you always answer from the text.
0325 pts
Writing

Production écrite

From a message of about 40 words at A1 to an argued text of at least 250 words at B2.

A writing studio with real prompts and a self-assessment grid.
0425 pts
Speaking

Production orale

An interview and a role-play at A1–A2, up to presenting and defending a point of view at B2.

A speaking studio: draw a subject card, record your answer, listen back.

To pass: 50/100 overall, with at least 5/25 in each of the four papers. The diploma is valid for life.

Méthode

Three steps, then a little every day

  1. 1

    Écrivez votre prénom

    No account and no password. Your progress is saved under your name, on this device.

  2. 2

    Choisissez votre objectif

    Tell Camille why you are taking the DELF. She suggests a level and builds your study plan around your exam date.

  3. 3

    Entraînez-vous, mesurez

    Practice exams, flashcards and the two studios feed one readiness score, so you always know where you stand.

Les niveaux

From your first bonjour to the B2 debate

Pick the level you are aiming for now. You can change it at any time, and practise the others too.

Your place in the exam room is waiting.
